$comment: Instances of our contracts on Aztec Alpha (mainnet, Ethereum L1 chain 1). contracts: empty, no escrow or stream of ours is deployed there, so agreements stay refused (lib/aztec/agreement-policy.ts). tokens: the operator's own token HLC (11 November 2026). Alpha runs real value and, in Aztec's words, is live but early, with critical bugs expected; our contracts have no external audit. An entry is added only with its transaction hash and block, after the read-only preflight (workflow "Aztec mainnet preflight") passes for the same artifacts. See docs/MAINNET_READINESS.md.
$tokensComment: Private tokens the wallet may list on Alpha (NEXT_PUBLIC_AZTEC_TOKENS must match these: scripts/aztec/check-alpha-config.mjs). key is the wallet's internal slot, never shown to users; symbol is what users see. deployBlock 0 (status pending-preflight) means not yet confirmed: the preflight (test/live/aztec-mainnet-preflight.live.test.ts) reads the block of deployTx from the node and prints it, together with the instance's class ID; both are then written here. Nothing is invented. HLC is issued by Humanity Ledger, is not backed by and has no relation to USDC.
